title: This Baby Bird Has Claws on Its Wings and Dives to Escape

scenes.text: This baby bird has claws on its wings.
It's a hoatzin, a pheasant-sized bird from the Amazon. Its chicks can't fly for about two months.
So when a predator comes, they don't fly. They drop into the water below.
Then they swim, and use those wing claws to climb back up to the nest.
Adults smell like manure, because they ferment leaves in an oversized crop, the way a cow does.
It's the only bird known to digest like a cow. Locals call it the stinkbird.
